district_archive_cabinet.title: Scholar's Archive Cabinet

district_cartographers_table.title: Frontier Cartographer's Table

district_mending_bench.title: Warden's Mending Bench
district_mending_bench.tip: Repairs compatible equipment and removes ordinary enchantments like a grindstone.
